# Durian Travel

> Europe trip planning for travellers based outside Europe. Country guides, route
> and budget planning, and free self-serve planners. Published by Durian Travel at
> https://www.duriantravel.com

Educational information only. Not legal advice. Always check the official embassy
or consulate source.

## What this site is

Durian Travel plans trips to Europe for people travelling from outside it, where
the distances are longer, the timing is tighter, and the border rules apply
differently than they do to someone crossing between two European countries.

The site covers 29 European country guides, route and budget planning, and the
documentation a Schengen application asks for. It does not submit applications on
anyone's behalf, and it does not predict or influence the outcome of any
application. Consular officers alone decide that.

## Free planners

- https://www.duriantravel.com/tools/budget/
  Trip budget calculator. Separates fixed costs from nightly costs, adds a buffer,
  and returns a total, a per-person figure, and a per-night figure. Runs entirely
  in the browser.

- https://www.duriantravel.com/tools/cost-per-country/
  Cost-per-country estimator across 28 European countries, ranked cheapest first.
  Built on Eurostat price level indices for restaurants and hotels, dataset
  prc_ppp_ind, indicator PLI_EU27_2020, reference year 2024, where the EU27
  average is 100.

- https://www.duriantravel.com/tools/visa-checklist/
  Schengen document checklist that adapts to whether the traveller is employed,
  self-employed, a student or retired. Counts documents gathered. It does not
  score readiness, because a complete file is not an approved visa.

## Key pages

- https://www.duriantravel.com/destinations/ — 29 country guides by region
- https://www.duriantravel.com/schengen-visa-guide/ — documents, costs, timelines
- https://www.duriantravel.com/blog/ — planning guides, routes, budgets, borders
- https://www.duriantravel.com/faq/ — what the service does and does not do
- https://www.duriantravel.com/free-visa-audit/ — free trip planning call
- https://www.duriantravel.com/about-us/ — who the site is for

## Sourcing

Figures on this site are published with their source, the reference year, and the
date they were last checked, so they can be verified rather than taken on trust.
Where two official sources disagree, the disagreement is published rather than
resolved by choosing one.

Authorship is organizational. Articles are credited to the Durian Travel editorial
team rather than to a named individual.

## Border rules

Border rules change. Anything on this site about EES, ETIAS, or Schengen visa
requirements should be checked against the official European Union sources before
it is relied on:

- https://travel-europe.europa.eu/etias_en
- https://home-affairs.ec.europa.eu/policies/schengen-borders-and-visa_en
